gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-mro: Audiowide draws every stroke at a single thickness, with wide-spaced, tile-like glyphs that give the headline a futuristic, machined look. Noto Sans Mro is the sturdy counterweight: dense, tall-bodied words with generous openings.
gen-fredoka-fs-recia: Soft, rod-like and friendly, Fredoka holds one line width throughout and leaves its e open with a clear gap. Recia then adds sturdy hairlines and light modulation, a sharper voice under the friendly heading.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-nabata: Noto Sans Nabataean stands its lowercase almost cap-tall, with generous s curves that stay crisp and contemporary under the heading. Almendra Display supplies the ornate, literary flourish; the body just reads.
gen-fs-oswald-fs-merriweather-sans: Tightly knit and confident, Oswald hits like a headline stamp. Merriweather Sans brings tall, sturdy lowercase and an open e, so text reads large and clean across many lines.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Almendra Display is all ornate, literary flourish, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height pronounced. Noto Sans Nushu is the opposite, with towering x-height and terminals held far from the stroke.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Audiowide strokes hold one thickness, like drawn cable. Noto Sans Ogham reads boldly because its lowercase bodies are so tall, with wide gaps in the e keeping text open.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-ol-chi: Letters that never pinch shut give Almendra Display its ornate, literary feel, with a pronounced x-height across every line. Noto Sans Ol Chiki forms solid blocks, so its size can stay modest.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ara: Noto Sans Old North Arabian forms a dense, tall lowercase band. Its terminals point outward like a pair of tongs, giving paragraphs a crisp texture, while Audiowide keeps the heading thickness constant.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-old-so: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary charm, with letters that never pinch shut and a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Old Sogdian reads crisply, tall letters holding up when shrunk.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Generous gaps in the curves and near-capital lowercase make the text read large beneath Almendra Display, the ornate, literary heading. Noto Sans Oriya can therefore stay modest in size.
